claim.claim-text: 1. A method, comprising:

2. The method of claim 1, wherein loading the one or more baseband receive parameters at the receiver node comprises configuring a baseband circuit of the receiver node with at least one of a specific automatic gain control (AGC) gain and a specific equalizer type.
3. The method of claim 1 or 2, wherein identifying the link based on the pre-payload portion comprises extracting current channel state information (CSI) from the pre-payload portion.
4. The method of any of claims 1-3, further comprising:

determining that a current signature of the identified link has changed and does not correlate to a historic signature of the identified link; and triggering a security event in response to determining that the current signature of the identified link has changed and does not correlate to the historic signature of the identified link.
5. The method of claim 3, wherein identifying the link based on the pre-payload portion further comprises determining a current signature of the current CSI.
6. The method of claim 5, wherein identifying the link based on the pre-payload portion further comprises correlating the current signature against a historic signature of each of one or more links.
7. The method of claim 6, wherein correlating the current signature against the historic signature of each of the one or more links includes:

calculating a distance metric between the current signature and the historic signature of each of the one or more links; and selecting a link of the one or more links with a historic signature that is closest to the current signature as the identified link.

8. The method of claim 6 or 7, further comprising loading the one or more historic signatures of the one or more links onto the receiver node, the historic signatures generated by a different device than the receiver node.
9. The method of any of claims 6-8, further comprising generating the historic signature of each of the one or more links.
10. The method of claim 9, wherein generating the historic signature of each of the one or more links comprises:
11. The method of any of claims 6-10, further comprising, after receiving the payload of the packet at the receiver node:

determining that the current signature of the identified link has changed and does not correlate to a historic signature of the identified link; and triggering a security event in response to determining that the current signature of the identified link has changed and does not correlate to the historic signature of the identified link.
12. The method of claim 11, wherein triggering the security event comprises disassociating the sender node from the receiver node.
13. The method of any of claims 1-12, wherein receiving the pre-payload portion of the packet comprises receiving a legacy-long training field (L-LTF) of the packet.
14. The method of any of claims 1-13, further comprising:

selecting one or more radio frequency (RF) receive parameters of the receiver node based on information included in or determined from the pre-payload portion of the packet; and receiving the payload of the packet at the receiver node using the one or more RF receive parameters.
